Research position overview

This Canterbury project examines advanced manufacturing approaches for restoring ageing bridges and improving their performance. The research combines civil infrastructure questions with manufacturing methods, supported by a three-year project scholarship.

Research Areas

  • Civil engineering
  • Advanced manufacturing
  • Bridge restoration

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 32,650/year plus tuition
DurationThree years
Research expensesUp to NZD 5,000 over the degree, separate from the annual stipend

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsThree-year project; engineering and manufacturing research.

About University of Canterbury

Canterbury offers doctoral study and university-funded scholarships in Christchurch. Applicants can seek general doctoral funding or compete for scholarships linked to a particular research project.
